prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an asymmetric three-panel cinematic street portrait study of the same adult woman in a bright cobalt-blue puffer jacket standing still in a busy city crowd. Panel one is an eye-level portrait with intense eye contact, shallow depth of field, and motion-blurred pedestrians around her. Panel two is a top-down view at a crowded zebra crossing, with people moving rapidly in a circular long-exposure blur. Panel three is an urban portrait with the blue jacket sharp, wind slightly moving her hair, and fast-moving crowd streaks surrounding her. Keep her adult identity, jacket, cool color grade, natural skin texture, and anonymous bystanders consistent across all panels. Use soft overcast daylight and editorial street-photography realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, recognizable bystanders, text, watermark, logo, mismatched panel identity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed
